पीठ

PĪṬHA . A demon. He was killed by śrī kṛṣṇa. (Śloka 5, Chapter 11, droṇa parva).

पिठर

PIṬHARA . A daitya who was a member of the court of varuṇa. (Śloka 13, Chapter 9, Sabhā Parva).

पिठरक

PIṬHARAKA (pīṭharaka) . A prominent serpent born in the family of kaśyapa. This was burnt to death in the sarpasatra of janamejaya. (Śloka 15, Chapter 57, Ādi Parva).
